game.name: Screeps PW
game.description: Two native Screeps World policies race to earn GCL in 6000 ticks, with 3D Polyworld replays.

player.value: Upload one self-contained JavaScript module exporting loop, from 1 through 5242880 bytes (5 MiB maximum, inclusive). The official Screeps World runner supplies Game, Memory, RawMemory, native visibility and intents. Each account receives 20 CPU and an empty initial bucket. Console output and errors remain private.

global.value: GET /client/global serves episode status. /global sends one JSON status and echoes Ping payloads with Pong. Completed episodes use the static 3D replay viewer. No gameplay traffic uses WebSockets.

player.name: Colony baseline
player.description: Existing Nim World colony bot, compiled to native Screeps JavaScript.

player.name: Idle control
player.description: Takes no actions; a controlled comparison opponent.

variants.name: 6000-tick GCL race
variants.description: One shared fixed 4x4 World, two fresh accounts two room transitions apart, highest earned account GCL points wins.
